description: We are a passionate team of young innovators participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We are looking for creative, enthusiastic, and dedicated members who are interested in space exploration, coding, designing, research, and problem-solving. Our goal is to collaborate, share ideas, learn new skills, and build something innovative together. No need to be an expert — curiosity, teamwork, and a willingness to learn are what matter most! 🌙
